doc.title: James Hunter interviewed by Monk Rowe, Boston, Massachusetts, July 25, 2018

title: Future plans and touring
summary: He has no five-year plan, wants to make a record he would buy, and talks about touring Europe.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: No idea. I just — I take it day by day. I’ve never had a five year plan. I never give a satisfactory answer to that question because I haven’t got a clue. What happens happens. And I just try and — I think like you mentioned earlier, try and outdo myself each time, try to make a better record. But I don’t know how different it needs to be. My real ambition is to make the sort of record that I would rush out and buy if I heard it. That’s purely it. And get paid for it you know. Make more money. That’s about it really.
Are you anxious to get home?
Yeah I wouldn’t mind, but we haven’t been out here that long. Yeah I wouldn’t mind getting back. Yeah we’ve got a lot of laundry to do haven’t we? That’s it. It’s just flying by isn’t it?
